newsitem.title: INDIA: India grants 100,000 T sugar export quota - paper.
newsitem.headline: India grants 100,000 T sugar export quota - paper.

text.p: An Indian newspaper said on Wednesday that the government had granted a fresh export quota of 100,000 tonnes of sugar to a private agency.

The Business Line newspaper said the government has allowed the Indian Sugar and General Industries Import Export Corporation (ISIGIEC) to export 100,000 tonnes of sugar in addition to an earlier allocation of 125,000 tonnes.

"In a surprise move, the centre has granted an additional export quota of 100,000 tonnes to ISIGIEC, which was earlier granted a quota of 125,000 tonnes," the newspaper said. It did not give the export period.
ISIGIEC is an export agency set up by private millers.
Government officials could not be immediately reached for confirmation.
The newspaper said the fresh export quota would be used to meet demand from Pakistan and Sri Lanka.
